## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Hold-out accuracy

```{r}
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2007 Q4")
fit <- train |> model(snaive = SNAIVE(Beer), ets = ETS(Beer))
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = 12)
fc |> accuracy(aus_production) |>
  select(.model, ME, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE)
```

## 2. Interpretation

Which metric would you report to a business partner? Why?
